compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of a color blindness test. It displays a test plate (number 4 out of 15) featuring a number composed of colored dots. Below the image, there are three options explaining what different people might see:

1. "5" - Those with normal color vision see a 5.
2. "2" - Those with red-green color blindness see a 2.
3. "Nothing" - Those with total color blindness see nothing.

At the bottom, there are two buttons for the user to select their response:
- "I SAW A 5." (green button)
- "I SAW SG. ELSE" (red button)

The screen is designed to help determine the type of color vision the user has based on their response to the test plate.
